_meta.method: Official home pages fetched first, then navigated via links / site JS bundles to the auction-results pages; all URLs below were fetched and returned the status shown. 'uncertain' marks anything not directly observed.
_meta.tools: curl via agent proxy (TLS verified), pdftotext -layout, pdffonts, pdfimages, openpyxl/xlrd (installed in scratchpad only)

sources.name: CBK Treasury bill auction results (91/182/364d)
sources.format: HTML page (wpDataTables) listing PDF links; one PDF per weekly auction covering all three tenors. ~1,581 PDF links split across folders /uploads/91_day_..., /182_day_..., /364_day_historical_treasury_bill_results/
fields_available: weighted average rate of accepted bids
sources.terms_of_use: No terms/reuse page linked from the page footer; only '© 2017 Central Bank of Kenya' (footer of https://www.centralbank.go.ke/bills-bonds/treasury-bills/). Reuse terms: not found.
sources.notes: Note /securities/treasury-bills/ (the seed URL) is an investor-info page; actual results are at /bills-bonds/treasury-bills/. Filenames embed issue numbers and dates; some older files are named '.xlsx.pdf'. The page is ~1.9 MB HTML.

sources.name: CBK Treasury bond auction results

fields_available: weighted average rate of accepted bids
sources.notes: Format of older (2007-2015) PDFs not checked; may differ / may be scanned (uncertain).

sources.name: NSE (Nairobi Securities Exchange) daily bond price list (secondary market)
sources.format: PDF 'BondPrices_DD-MMM-YYYY.pdf' linked from market-statistics; sample https://www.nse.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/BondPrices_02-OCT-2026.pdf (200)
sources.text_or_scanned: SCANNED/IMAGE: 2 pages, each a single 2480x3507 RGB image, no fonts (Producer PDFill) -> needs OCR
sources.terms_of_use: NSE terms (https://www.nse.co.ke/terms-and-conditions/): 'The intellectual property rights (“IPR”) inducing, without limitation, copyright in the Historical Data in the form as it is received, shall be vested at all times with the NSE.' NSE sells historical/EOD data (pricelist PDFs linked).
sources.notes: https://www.nse.co.ke/government-bonds/ (seed URL, 200) is descriptive only, no data. Free but not machine-readable; licensing of redistribution unclear -> treat as restricted.

UGA.usable_now: partial (2017-2024 text PDFs yes; 2026 template needs OCR)

sources.name: Bank of Uganda auction results (via site's Strapi API)
sources.format: JSON index (title, year, month, file url) -> PDF files under https://bou.or.ug/uploads/ ; 368 'Auction results' items: 354 PDF, 12 XLS/XLSX (2018, 2022), 1 DOCX (30-Sep-2026 T-bill)
sources.cadence: T-bills about every 2 weeks; T-bonds about twice a month (Sep 2026: bills 02 & 30 Sep; bonds 09 & 23 Sep)
fields_missing: weighted average yield (bills show MMY at cut-off only)
sources.text_or_scanned: MIXED: 2024 sample is a text PDF (Excel-generated, clean pdftotext). 2026 samples (new '60' template, PDFium/InDesign) have header text only; the table glyphs are vector outlines (no fonts, no images) -> needs render+OCR
sources.terms_of_use: https://bou.or.ug/terms_and_condition (API https://bou.or.ug/api/terms-and-condition?populate=terms): 'BOU is pleased to allow Users to visit the Site and download and copy the information, documents and materials (collectively, "Materials") from the Site for User use subject to the terms and conditions outlined below and also subject to more specific restrictions that may apply to specific material within this Site.' Footer: '© 2026 Bank of Uganda. All rights reserved.'
sources.notes: www.bou.or.ug is a React SPA; the human page is /financial-market-auction-information (route seen in bundle). Same API also lists 'Invitation to tender' (780 items, 2001-2026).

sources.name: BoU Daily Secondary Market Trades (government securities)

sources.name: Bank of Tanzania T-bill auction results

sources.terms_of_use: Disclaimer only (Swahili default) https://www.bot.go.tz/Home/Disclaimer : 'Benki Kuu ya Tanzania haitawajibika kwa hasara, madhara au athari yoyote itakayotokana na kutegemea taarifa zilizomo kwenye tovuti hii au zinazopatikana kupitia tovuti hii.' sources.name: BNR T-bill market history (XLSX)
sources.format: XLSX, sheet 'T-BILL MARKET' ~2,750 rows, one row per tenor per auction (filename changes each update; discoverable via JSON index https://www.bnr.rw/search)
fields_missing: cut-off price (present in per-auction PDF, not in history sheet)
sources.terms_of_use: BNR 'Terms of Use for Official Statistics' (https://www.bnr.rw/statuse; SPA route, text in site bundle): 'The official statistics provided by NBR are available under A Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International ... Data published are free to use and Users may: Access, download, and use the statistics for personal, commercial, academic, or research purposes. Share or redistribute the statistics, provided the source National Bank of Rwanda is clearly acknowledged.' Attribution: 'Source: National Bank of Rwanda'.
sources.notes: Best licence found in the survey (CC BY 4.0). Mixed date formats (DD.MM.YYYY recent, M/D/YYYY old).
